summary.text: Adrienne White Carden, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2026 and represents Senate District 7, which includes Berkeley Lake, Duluth, and parts of Lawrenceville, Peachtree Corners, Norcross, and Suwanee, according to the legislative biography.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Carden as a senior vice president and relationship manager at SouthState Bank, and says Carden previously worked at Ernst & Young, the Coca-Cola Company, the National Center for Human Rights, and Citizens Trust Bank.
The biography says Carden chairs the board of Hands On Atlanta, served as Vice Chair of Candidate Recruitment for the Democratic Party of Georgia, and lives in Duluth.
